summary: Frontend-only deep test of the LIVE EDITOR plus homepage responsiveness (1920/1280/1024/820/390). Before testing I took a full DB backup of pages/settings/notes (/app/tests/backup_restore_content.py). After each mutating test I restored the original imported content and checked it with a diff, so the client's content is unchanged (final diff is clean). WORKING: login, then Live Editor (opens /?edit=1 in a new tab). Click-to-edit text (contentEditable). Save button and Ctrl+S both publish, and the change shows publicly after reload. Esc deselects. Ctrl+Z, the Undo/Redo buttons and the status going back to 'Everything is saved' all work. The move grip, the east resize handle, and the Move X / Width fields work, and the result persists publicly. Arrow / Shift+Arrow nudges a selected photo by 1px / 10px. All 7 crop shapes, the zoom slider (180%) and drag-to-pan work and persist publicly. Replacing a photo from the media library (41 items) works and persists. Header editor text fields save. Text editing and undo work on /about, /field-notes, /connect, all 4 /our-work/* pages and a field note. Responsive: no horizontal overflow at any of the 5 widths, the mobile MENU opens the nav, and the 'Explore Field Notes' link shows about 20px below the cards. BROKEN: (1) the device preview overlay is covered by the site header, so 'Back to editing' cannot be clicked; (2) most Header 'Style & spacing' controls save but have no effect because existing CSS outranks them; (3) Site-text styles do not apply to several fields; (4) the Field Notes title is still bigger than the other homepage section titles; (5) a React setState-in-render warning on undo.

ui_bugs.issue: HIGH: the preview overlay (.live-preview, z-index 100060) is rendered inside <main>. <main> has position:relative and z-index:1, which makes it its own stacking context, so the overlay cannot rise above the site header (#site-header, sticky, z-index 30). The header covers the preview bar, so 'Back to editing' and the mobile/tablet toggles cannot be clicked (Playwright: '#site-header intercepts pointer events') at 1920 and 1280. The only way out is 'Close editor' in the dock, which throws away unsaved changes. Repro: Live editor > click the phone icon (live-device-mobile) > try to click 'Back to editing'. Fix: render the preview overlay with createPortal(..., document.body), or hide the header while body.live-editing has a preview open.

HIGH: header style overrides save to DB (settings.header_styles) and the <style data-testid=header-style-overrides> tag is rendered. But its rules ('#public-site #site-header ...', 2 ids) lose to more specific !important rules, so nothing changes in the live preview or on the public site. Examples: background is overridden by site-overrides.css:71 'html body #public-site#public-site.site #site-header {background:#fff !important}' and index.css:1667; brand size is overridden by header-height.css:6 '#public-site.site #site-header .brand-name {font-size:32px !important}'. Subtitle size, menu size and weight, min-height and padding likely lose to header-height.css as well (only checked by reading the CSS). Nav background is overridden by boxed-layout.css:244. Repro: Edit Header > Style & spacing > Header background #123456, Brand size 40 > Save header. Status says 'All changes saved', but the public header stays white and brand-name stays 32px. Fix: raise the selector specificity in HeaderStyleTag, e.g. prefix with 'html body #public-site#public-site.site #site-header#site-header'.

MEDIUM: (a) Font size does not apply to header fields because of the same specificity problem: full_name/header at size 20 stays 11px (header-height.css .brand-sub 11px !important), while colour does apply. (b) 'display.copyright' (Footer copyright) does nothing: footer-copyright in PublicLayout.jsx:104 has no data-site-style='display.copyright' attribute, so textSelector matches nothing. (c) The default field 'tagline' (area footer) is not rendered anywhere on the public site, so saving it has no visible effect. (d) No footer text is clickable to open Site text: the only footer [data-site-edit] is the hidden privacy_html; email, copyright and 'Privacy Policy' have no data-site-edit.

LOW: on small or narrow elements the dark move grip (.live-move-grip) is drawn on top of the section toolbar (.live-sectools). It covers the 'Move down' button on the small Featured-note photo and part of 'Add section below' on headings.

LOW: for text elements the hint says 'use the arrow keys (Shift = 10px)', but the code only nudges with arrows when the selection is not text (LiveEditor.jsx line 449, !isText). Text that is being edited moves the caret instead. Either hide the hint for text or mention that arrows only nudge photos and sections.

LOW: on /our-work/theatre the first image (theatre-split-art) gets the new ratio on its , but the figure keeps a fixed height of 536px. 16:9 therefore shows as a letterboxed or overflowing image, not as a re-framed box (figure ratio stayed 1.42).

issues: The title uses var(--ts-h2), which computes to 33.92px at 1920, 30.08px at 1280, 28.5px at 1024, 27.3px at 820 and 26px at 390. The other section h2s ('Heritage, Art and Culture', 'Shaped by Place', 'The Value Can Extend') are 28px at every width, because the client saved fontSize:28px on them in the live editor (section styles.heading). So at desktop the Field Notes title is still about 6px larger than the titles above it. It only matches the CTA 'Be Part of What Takes Shape Next.' (ts-h2). To match visually, use 28px (or whatever the other headings compute to).

The imported homepage content has a placeholder text section (id u4xulx89re) that is published and visible, showing 'New heading' / 'New paragraph. Click to edit this text.' above the footer. Not created by testing (it was in the DB before the backup). Ask the user whether to remove it.
The fixed editor panel on the right covers page content at x>1300 (e.g. the Featured note photo on home). It can be dragged away, so this is minor.

action_items: HIGH: render the device preview overlay (.live-preview) in a portal on document.body (or otherwise escape the <main> z-index:1 stacking context), so 'Back to editing' and the device toggles can be clicked above #site-header.

HIGH: raise selector specificity in HeaderStyleTag.jsx (e.g. 'html body #public-site#public-site.site #site-header#site-header ...') so the header Style & spacing settings beat header-height.css, site-overrides.css, index.css:1667 and boxed-layout.css !important rules.
MEDIUM: raise specificity in TextStyleTag.jsx in the same way so font-size works for header and footer site text.
MEDIUM: make footer email and Privacy link editable, and either render 'tagline' or remove it from the Site text field list and default.

MEDIUM: fix the setState-in-render warning ('Cannot update a component (PageBody) while rendering a different component (Editor)'). In LiveEditor.jsx undo()/redo() (lines 161-172), setContent() and remount() are called inside the setHist updater function. Compute prev/next from the current hist and call setContent/remount outside the updater.
MEDIUM: make the homepage Field Notes title match the other section h2s (currently 33.9px vs 28px at desktop).
LOW: stop the move grip covering the section toolbar buttons on small elements.
LOW: hide or fix the arrow-key hint for text elements.
Ask the user about the published placeholder 'New heading' section on the homepage.
critical_code_review_comments: LiveEditor.jsx is 695 lines, close to the 700-line limit. Consider moving drag, resize and pan into a hook (useDragTransforms) and the keyboard shortcuts into another hook.
undo/redo have side effects inside the state updater, which breaks under StrictMode and causes the React warning.
The keyboard effect has no dependency array and re-subscribes on every render. It works, but it is wasteful.
Because of the CSS !important cascade in the reference stylesheets, editor override tags must always use higher specificity. There is no shared helper, so header and text overrides silently fail.

success_rate.frontend: about 80% (core page editing: text, save, Ctrl+S, undo, Esc, move, resize, crop, zoom, pan, media replace and multi-page all pass; device preview exit, header style, site-text styles and Field Notes title size fail)

seed_data_creation: None kept. All test edits (heading text, move/width, image crop/zoom/pan/replace, header full_name + styles, site tagline + styles) were restored from the backup. DB diff against the original is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Before any mutating test, run 'python /app/tests/backup_restore_content.py backup', and afterwards run 'restore' and then 'diff'. A copy of the original imported content is at /app/tests/.content_backup_iter2.json; copy it to /tmp/content_backup.json before using restore. The theatre and rakhigarhi pages are at /our-work/theatre and /our-work/rakhigarhi (/theatre returns 404). Live editor login: /admin, then navigate to /?edit=1. Expected 401s on /api/auth/me and /api/auth/refresh for anonymous users. Retest: device preview close button, header style overrides on the public site, site-text fontSize on header/footer, Field Notes h2 size vs the 28px headings.
rca of the issue: Preview overlay: .live-preview is a child of <main> (position:relative; z-index:1). That makes <main> its own stacking context, so z-index 100060 only applies inside <main>, and the sibling sticky #site-header (z 30) paints on top. Header styles: HeaderStyleTag emits '#public-site #site-header X {.. !important}' (specificity 2,0,1 or 2,1,0). header-height.css and site-overrides.css use '#public-site.site #site-header .brand-name' (2,2,0) and 'html body #public-site#public-site.site #site-header' (3,1,2), also !important, so they win. Field Notes size: per-element live-editor styles fix the other headings at 28px, while the Field Notes title follows the fluid --ts-h2 scale.
